subject: balanced_two_complete_browser_paths

environment.power: AC attached; no system cache flush

quantile: nearest-rank; n=20 uses sorted item 19 for p95
hotDefinition: New dedicated browser for each attempt; navigate and initialize selected engine before timer; then reread, open, extract, compare and locate both PDFs; no document/result reuse. One engine active at a time.
memoryMethod: macOS footprint: fixed about:blank baseline before app/engine; sum of per-process lifetime physical peaks at completion minus baseline, including app/worker/WASM/native/GPU. Also sampled process-tree RSS. Export is performed only after memory capture. Per-process peaks can occur at different times, so their sum is conservative.
